assets.title: The Abbey Gate
assets.description: Moonlit abbey entrance environment study for a side-scrolling Gothic action-platformer.
assets.intendedUse: Visual direction reference; flattened environment concept.

validation.visualReview: Theme and mood accepted by project owner.

limitations: Single flattened image; layers are not separated.
Not a seamless tile or collision map.

assets.title: Bellwarden motion pilot
assets.intendedUse: Eight prototype poses with atlas foot pivots; runtime magenta-key compositing.
limitations: Opaque source; not a native transparent sprite sheet.
Four walk poses and three attack poses require animation cleanup.
Jump temporarily reuses a walk pose.

assets.title: Abbey masonry module
assets.intendedUse: Repeated platform face with deliberate mortar joins.
limitations: Not guaranteed seamless; no end caps or corners.

assets.title: The Hollow Pilgrim
assets.description: Wandering Gothic penitent hostile silhouette in ragged slate vestments, carrying a cracked bell-topped staff.
assets.intendedUse: Candidate enemy design fulfilling M0/M2 roadmap; slow-advancing wandering encounter.

validation.visualReview: Compliant with ART_DIRECTION palette (#151822, #333D58, #8292A6, #D99A52); crisp 2D orthographic side profile.
validation.engineIntegration: Pending sprite cleanup, animation frames, and collision bounds

limitations: Requires multi-pose animation sheet (walk, swing, hit-reaction, perish) before engine integration.

assets.title: Hanging Bell Brazier
assets.description: Wrought-iron Gothic bell-censer brazier suspended by chains with warm amber ember glow.
assets.intendedUse: Interactive destructible prop replacing classic candle/torch archetype; releases sanctified embers when struck.

validation.visualReview: Adheres to moonlit slate highlights (#8292A6) and amber flame (#D99A52); orthographic side elevation.
validation.engineIntegration: Accompanied by atlas definition with attachment anchor and strike box

limitations: Opaque background; intended for color-keying or alpha masking in production.
Destruction and swing animation frames pending.

assets.title: Consecration Ember Pickup
assets.description: Sacred bell-metal relic shard enveloped in radiant amber consecrated fire.
assets.intendedUse: Loot drop and sanctified collectible released upon shattering hanging censers.

validation.visualReview: High-contrast silhouette legible at 32-48px gameplay scale against deep shadow recesses.
validation.engineIntegration: Atlas metadata includes pickup bounds and light radius

limitations: Single frame study; bobbing and glimmer shader/frames planned for M3.

assets.title: Abbey Masonry End-Cap Module
assets.description: Weathered Gothic limestone platform end-cap and broken edge terminal.
assets.intendedUse: Platform termination piece to cap raw cuts on causeway edges and raised ledges.

validation.visualReview: Continuous flat limestone top surface matching masonry-module-v001 stone cap height and palette.

limitations: Right-hand end-cap; left-hand edge can be mirrored or complemented with dedicated left variant.

assets.title: Bellwarden Airborne Motion Study
assets.description: Three dedicated airborne poses for the Bellwarden: jump takeoff/ascent, apex tuck, and descending fall with drawn blade.
assets.intendedUse: Replaces the temporary passing pose during jump/fall states with dedicated jump frames.

validation.visualReview: Consistent with Bellwarden pale mantle, leather corslet, and straight sword; orthographic side profile.
validation.engineIntegration: Atlas defines jump-ascent, jump-apex, and jump-descent frames and foot pivots

limitations: Opaque dark background; requires color-keying or alpha mask for production.

assets.title: Distant Abbey Skyline Parallax Layer
assets.description: Distant Gothic bell towers, spires, and mountain ridges under the moonlit sky without foreground obstruction.
assets.intendedUse: Distant parallax background layer enabling independent scrolling behind playable masonry.

validation.visualReview: Atmospheric haze and rim lighting (#8292A6) matching ART_DIRECTION palette; zero foreground collision geometry.
validation.engineIntegration: Suitable for canvas drawImage with fractional parallax scroll factor

limitations: Fixed width panoramic section; seamless horizontal tiling wrap requires seam blend.

assets.title: Hollow Pilgrim Motion Pilot
assets.description: Four-pose enemy animation sequence: idle stance, shuffling stride, overhead staff windup, and downward bell strike impact.
assets.intendedUse: First enemy motion sheet fulfilling M2 roadmap criteria.

validation.visualReview: Consistent anatomy, staff design, and amber eyes across all 4 action poses.
validation.engineIntegration: Atlas defines idle, shuffle, windup, and strike bounds with foot anchors

limitations: Opaque dark background; requires alpha extraction.
Hit recoil and death ash dissolve frames planned for next phase.

assets.title: Abbey Buttress Pillar & Arch Segment
assets.description: Modular Gothic architectural pillar with blind tracery lancets and springing ribbed arch.
assets.intendedUse: Modular vertical architectural divider and archway support between platforms.

validation.visualReview: Matches worn limestone texture and mortar joint styling of masonry-module-v001 and masonry-endcap-v001.
validation.engineIntegration: Flat base aligns directly with platform collision bounds

limitations: Single left-side springing arch; matching right-side arch spring can be mirrored.
